lane B's measurement reproduces: request_id appears 0 times in backend/app/main.py, and there is no X-Request-Id header and no middleware that adds one (0 hits for request-id/middleware in the whole file). ORD-0332's real question is therefore not 'emit request_id' but 'expose the trace_id that already exists, under which name'
